strings.en_src: We're in the Tricycle. Where shall￥we go?

Gillian's home

Queen Hospital

strings.en_src: Gillian, where are you going!￥Hurry to Queen Hospital!!
strings.long_src: Where are you going, Gillian? We￥need to hurry to Queen Hospital!

strings.en_src: It's too late to get cold feet now!
Let's head for the Snatchers' base!
There's no time, Gillian! Let's go￥straight to Queen Hospital.

strings.long_src: It's hopeless! We're finished!

strings.en_src: Don't give up yet! There has to be a￥way out!

strings.long_src: What are you going to do?

strings.en_src: No good! Gillian!￥A short while, but...
strings.long_src: It's no use, Gillian! We haven't￥known each other long, but
strings.long: Бесполезно, Гиллиан! Мы были знакомы￥недолго, но

strings.en_src: Quiet! There must be a way!
strings.long_src: Shut up! There has to be a way!

strings.en: Невозможно! Мы несёмся больше 250￥километров в час. Нам не выжить!
strings.en_src: Impossible.￥We're at 250 kph...￥There's no surviving it!
strings.long_src: Impossible! We're going over 250￥kilometers an hour. We can't survive￥this!
Damn it! We're going faster and￥faster!

strings.en_src: It won't stop!￥I'm out of ideas...!
strings.long_src: I can't stop! I can't take this! I￥don't know anymore!
strings.long: Не остановить! Не могу больше! Я уже￥ничего не понимаю!

strings.en: Сделаю что угодно, лишь бы выжить!
strings.en_src: I'll do anything to stay alive!
No good!￥The door is rigged and won't open!
strings.long_src: No! The door's been tampered with￥too. It won't open!

strings.en: Даже если откроется, на такой￥скорости нас разорвёт!
strings.en_src: Even if it opened, we'd be torn￥apart at this speed!
Blast the lock and the door￥should open!
strings.long_src: If I shoot the lock with my Blaster,￥the door should open!
strings.long: Если прострелить замок из бластера,￥дверь откроется!

strings.en_src: Open or not, jumping at this￥speed is certain death!!
strings.long_src: Even if it opens, jumping out at￥this speed would kill you!
strings.long: Даже если откроется, прыгать на￥такой скорости - верная смерть!

strings.long_src: Destroying the door will only make￥things more dangerous!

strings.en: Не делай глупостей! Это же прыжок в￥омут с головой!
strings.en_src: Don't do anything reckless! That's￥really taking a leap of faith!

strings.long_src: Isn't that the wrong expression?

strings.en_src: No good.￥Past 80 kph the safety trips￥and we can't lift off.
strings.long_src: No. The safety system prevents￥takeoff above 80 kilometers an hour.
strings.long: Нет. Система безопасности не даёт￥взлететь на скорости выше 80￥километров в час.

strings.en_src: What! Some safety!￥Sticking useless junk on it!
strings.long_src: What? Some safety system! Why'd they￥put that damn thing in?
strings.long: Что? Какая ещё система безопасности!￥Зачем было ставить эту дрянь?

strings.en_src: Releasing the safety needs￥a special tool!
strings.long_src: We need special tools to disable the￥safety system!

strings.en_src: No tool, so it's no go.
strings.long_src: We can't without the tools.

strings.en_src: Why didn't you bring the tools,￥＠赤idiot?!
The one saying fool is a fool!￥Gillian, ＠赤fool!
strings.long_src: Takes one to know one! You're the￥＠赤idiot, Gillian!
strings.long: Кто обзывается, тот сам так￥называется! Сам ты ＠赤дурак, Гиллиан!

strings.long_src: Give up

strings.en: Да заткнись ты! Ладно, сейчас￥что-нибудь сделаю!
strings.en_src: Shut up, will you? All right, I'll￥do something!

strings.long_src: You've got to be kidding me!

strings.en: Так! Бьюсь об стену! Держись, Метал!
strings.en_src: Right! We hit the wall!￥Metal, hold on!
strings.long_src: All right! I'm hitting the wall!￥Hold on, Metal!

strings.en_src: I'll hit the wall again! Here goes!
No good!￥We'll break up before we stop!
strings.long_src: No good! We'll fall apart before we￥stop!
strings.long: Не выйдет! Мы развалимся раньше, чем￥остановимся!

strings.long_src: Drive into sand

strings.en_src: I'm heading into the sand! Hold on￥tight!
I'll try the sand again! Here goes!

strings.long_src: Damn it! Still no good!
Press button

strings.en: Пан или пропал. Попробую эту кнопку!
strings.en_src: All or nothing. I'll try this￥button!

strings.en: Ты включил радио, Гиллиан! Что ты￥делаешь?
strings.en_src: The radio came on, Gillian! What are￥you doing!
strings.long_src: You've turned on the radio, Gillian!￥What are you doing?
All right, this button next!

strings.en: Тяга выросла на 23 процента! Что￥теперь, Гиллиан?
strings.en_src: Thrust is up 23 percent! What now,￥Gillian?

strings.long_src: We've reached a comfortable￥temperature!

strings.en: Что почувствует Джейми, если я умру?
strings.en_src: How would Jamie feel if I died?

strings.en: Она поплачет. А может, тут же меня￥забудет.
strings.en_src: She'd cry. But maybe she'd forget me￥right away.

strings.en: Потом выйдет за другого. А он,￥может, окажется мерзавцем, который￥её бьёт.
strings.en_src: Then she'd marry another man. He￥might even be a violent bastard.
Poor Jamie would hide from her￥husband and cry over my picture.
strings.long: Бедная Джейми будет тайком от мужа￥плакать над моей фотографией.

strings.en: Я не умру! Ни за что!

strings.en_src: If we don't stop, I'm going to die.
Every bone would shatter...￥It would hurt...
strings.long_src: Every bone in my body will break.￥It's going to hurt.

strings.en_src: No! I don't want to die!
